# NEAR OutLayer

> Verifiable off-chain computation for NEAR. You publish a WASI program to GitHub; OutLayer compiles it, runs it inside an Intel TDX enclave, and returns the result signed by the enclave — callable from a NEAR smart contract or over HTTPS. Agents get encrypted secrets, persistent storage, and TEE-held wallets that can sign for NEAR, EVM and Solana without a key ever leaving the enclave.

Two integration modes. **On-chain:** a NEAR contract calls `request_execution` and receives the result in a callback. **Web2:** a backend calls `POST https://api.outlayer.fastnear.com/call/{project_owner}/{project_name}` over HTTPS.

**API base URL is `https://api.outlayer.fastnear.com`** — the `api.` subdomain. `https://outlayer.fastnear.com` is the dashboard and docs site and serves no API. Testnet API base is `https://testnet-api.outlayer.fastnear.com`.

HTTPS authentication is either a payment key (`X-Payment-Key: {owner}:{nonce}:{secret}`) or a trial worker key (`Authorization: Bearer wk_...`). There is no `X-API-Key` header.

Mainnet contract: `outlayer.near`. Testnet contract: `outlayer.testnet`. NEAR RPC: `https://rpc.mainnet.fastnear.com` / `https://rpc.testnet.fastnear.com`.

Full text of every document below is available in one fetch at https://outlayer.fastnear.com/llms-full.txt.

## Start here

- [Getting Started](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/getting-started): What OutLayer is, the two integration modes (NEAR contract callback vs. HTTPS API), and a first working agent
- [Examples](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/examples): Runnable example agents: verifiable randomness, price and weather oracles, AI inference, NEAR Intents swaps, private DAO voting, 2FA, Telegram bot, on-chain email

## Guides

- [NEAR Contract Integration](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/near-integration): Calling `request_execution` from a NEAR contract: arguments, callback shape, gas and payment, FastFS workflow, attestation of the returned result
- [Web2 Integration](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/web2-integration): Using OutLayer from an ordinary backend over HTTPS: quick start, monetization, environment variables, attestation, project capabilities
- [WASI Guide](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/wasi): Writing the agent itself: WASI Preview 1 vs. Preview 2, supported languages, host functions, resource limits, local testing, common pitfalls
- [Developer Guide](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/dev-guide): End-to-end path: write WASI code, push to GitHub, test on testnet, integrate from a contract

## Features

- [Agent Custody](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/agent-custody): TEE-held wallets for agents: agent IDs, multi-chain signing, policy engine, multisig approval, confidential NEAR Intents, NEP-413 message signing, sub-agents
- [MPC Vaults](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/vaults): Per-customer sovereign vaults: creation, vault-scoped secrets and wallets, recovery procedures, end-user verification, threat model
- [Payment Checks](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/payment-checks): Gasless agent-to-agent payments: transfer mechanism, key derivation, check lifecycle, security model
- [Secrets](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/secrets): Encrypted secrets decrypted only inside the enclave: binding types, access control, storage costs, confidential key derivation (CKD), DAO-governed keystore
- [Projects](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/projects): Project IDs, how a WASM binary is bound to a project, project environment variables, version management, storage security model
- [Storage](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/storage): Persistent key-value storage for agents: methods reference, atomic operations, per-user isolation, public storage and its external HTTP read API
- [VRF](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/vrf): Verifiable randomness: SDK usage, on-chain proof verification, security properties, user-side verification
- [SDK](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/sdk): The Rust `outlayer` crate: environment module, storage module, minimal project template, API reference
- [HTTPS API](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/https-api): Request and response format for `POST /call/{project_owner}/{project_name}`: base URLs per network, headers, body, environment variables, error codes
- [Payment Keys](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/payment-keys): Creating payment keys, key format, restrictions, balance management, rate limits, security practices
- [Earnings](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/earnings): How developers earn from blockchain and HTTPS calls, checking attached payment inside WASM, viewing and withdrawing balances
- [Pricing](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/pricing): Dynamic pricing model, cost calculation, resource limits, refund policy

## Trust and verification

- [TEE Attestation](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/tee-attestation): What a worker signature proves: worker registration, post-quantum keys, per-execution attestation, data freshness, verification process
- [Trust and Verification](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/docs/trust-verification): Verifying the whole stack: five-measurement Intel TDX verification, Sigstore-signed release images, ephemeral keys and their on-chain trail, deterministic keystore secrets

## Machine-readable specs

- [OpenAPI specification](https://api.outlayer.fastnear.com/openapi.json): Complete HTTPS API schema — endpoints, request and response types, error codes
- [Agent Custody skill file](https://skills.outlayer.ai/agent-custody/SKILL.md): Canonical agent-framework skill for custody: registration, funding, transfers, swaps, cross-chain deposit and withdraw, NEP-413 signing, sub-agents, error handling
- [Full documentation text](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/llms-full.txt): Every document listed here, inlined in a single file

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/fastnear/near-outlayer): Contract, worker, keystore, dashboard, SDK and WASI examples
- [Worker attestation portal](https://workers.outlayer.ai): Live Intel TDX attestation status of the production worker fleet
- [Playground](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/playground): Run an agent from the browser without writing an integration
- [Dashboard](https://outlayer.fastnear.com/dashboard): Projects, secrets, payment keys, executions and earnings
